Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Game: Path-drawing puzzle on orthogonal grid. Goal: Connect all shapes with continuous path. CONFIRMED mechanics: Click shape to start path (activates with double border, fills green). Move pointer WITHOUT holding button to extend path through orthogonally adjacent cells (path follows pointer). Click to submit. Right-click resets puzzle. X button (~0.96,0.10) exits to level select.

Navigation: Level selection '1-1' tile initially unresponsive to clicks. Successfully entered 1-1-1 after scrolling and clicking (0.958,0.5). Within levels: right arrow (0.958,0.5) advances, left arrow goes back. Levels 1-1-1 through 1-1-3 pre-solved.

Level 1-1-4 (CURRENT): 4×4 grid, 4 shapes: square (r1c1), triangle (r1c4), star (r4c1), circle (r4c4).

First attempt: Started from center cell r3c3 (double border). Successfully created path connecting all four shapes: r3c3→up to r1c3→branching left to square and right to triangle→down column 1 to star→right along row 4 to circle. All shapes filled green but click at (0.5,0.66) did not submit solution. Hypothesis: r3c3 as non-shape starting point may invalidate solution.

Second attempt (CURRENT): Right-clicked to reset. Clicked square at r1c1 to activate it (now filled green with double border). Successfully extending path: square→r1c2→r1c3→triangle at r1c4. Last action moved to triangle. Triangle connection result unknown.

Route plan: square→triangle→down to circle→left to star. Path extends via pointer movement through adjacent cells only; cannot jump gaps. Starting from shape (square) rather than empty cell may be required for valid solution.
